summary: We are seeking a Cybersecurity Presales Engineer to join our Small and Medium-Sized Business (SMB) team. The successful candidate will play a meaningful role in winning customers' trust and ensuring their success.
responsibilities: Partner with Account Executives to strategize on territory, account, and opportunity planning.
Engage directly with prospective clients, building trusting relationships, understanding their needs, and demonstrating how our cybersecurity solutions can protect and empower their businesses.
required_skills: Communicating, storytelling, and translating sometimes sophisticated technology in an approachable way to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
A Desire to win and be a part of a successful sales team!
Detailed understanding of cyber security and networking technologies, concepts, standards, methods, operations, and uses.
nice_to_have_skills: Validated experience in presales, SMB-focused roles, or similar customer-facing positions.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, or similar credentials.
Multilingual capabilities, enabling you to connect with a broader range of customers.
